facts.claim: Silver Muse (Silversea Cruises): Entered service 2017; 40,700 GT; 550 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 213 m length; Muse class.
Silver Muse is a cruise ship owned by Silversea Cruises.
It is the lead ship of Silversea's Muse-class, the first of its kind, and was followed by her sister ships Silver Moon (2020) and Silver Dawn (2021).
